title: Decreases in Left Atrial Strain With Mavacamten Therapy and Associations With Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: In obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, the cardiac myosin inhibitor mavacamten improves left ventricular outflow tract obstruction and functional capacity. Symptoms and exertional capacity in obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy are also influenced by left atrial function, commonly assessed by left atrial strain (LAS). Current data regarding effects of cardiac myosin inhibitors on LAS are mixed. To assess changes in LAS in patients on mavacamten and correlate strain patterns to atrial fibrillation (AF) development. Serial echocardiograms were obtained following mavacamten initiation. We remeasured 2-dimensional and Doppler-derived measurements and obtained strain measurements. We examined temporal changes in LAS and related parameters, including those determining atrial preload and afterload, along with ventricular changes affecting atrial function. We included 434 echocardiograms from 65 patients. After 24 weeks of therapy, left ventricular outflow tract gradient, global longitudinal strain, and left ventricular ejection fraction all decreased. Left atrial volume index (p <0.001), mitral regurgitation severity (p = 0.01), and E/e' velocities (p = 0.01) also decreased. All 3 components of LAS worsened (p <0.001). Seven patients with baseline AF had recurrences, and 4 others had new-onset AF. LAS predicted AF as a time-dependent variable. Decreases in LAS seen with mavacamten may be downstream effects of alterations to other hemodynamic parameters, a decline in atrial function, or a combination thereof. LAS reductions may therefore represent harmful effects on the left atrium or neutral byproducts of other changes, although the association between LAS and AF is notable and may highlight prognostic implications of strain measurements in this population.

AI.tldr: 在65例梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者的434份系列超声中，马凡卡姆腾治疗24周后左房应变三项组分均显著恶化，且左房应变可作为预测房颤发生的时间依赖变量。
AI.motivation: 梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者的症状与运动耐量受左房功能影响，左房应变（LAS）是常用评估指标；但心脏肌球蛋白抑制剂对LAS的影响既往数据不一致，且LAS变化与房颤（AF）发生的关系尚不明确，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性（系列超声）研究，纳入65例启动马凡卡姆腾治疗的梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者，共434份超声心动图。分析马凡卡姆腾启动后的系列超声，重新测量二维及多普勒参数并获取应变指标，观察LAS及其时间变化，同时纳入决定左房前负荷、后负荷的参数及影响左房功能的心室改变；终点为LAS变化及AF发生（基线AF复发与新发AF），采用时间依赖变量模型评估LAS对AF的预测价值。摘要未报告具体统计方法细节。
AI.result: 治疗24周后，左室流出道压差、整体纵向应变及左室射血分数均下降；左房容积指数（p<0.001）、二尖瓣反流程度（p=0.01）及E/e'（p=0.01）亦降低；而LAS三项组分全部恶化（p<0.001）。7例基线AF患者复发，另4例新发AF；LAS作为时间依赖变量可预测AF。摘要未报告效应量与95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 马凡卡姆腾治疗后LAS下降，可能继发于其他血流动力学参数改变、心房功能本身减退或两者兼有，因而既可能是对左房的不利影响，也可能是其他变化的伴随结果；LAS与AF的显著关联提示应变测量在该人群具有预后意义。局限性包括样本量小、单中心、缺乏对照或盲法、AF事件数少、摘要未报告效应量与置信区间，需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 在梗阻性肥厚型心肌病中，心肌肌球蛋白抑制剂 mavacamten 可改善左心室流出道梗阻和功能容量。梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者的症状和运动耐量也受左心房功能影响，左心房功能通常通过左心房应变（LAS）评估。目前关于心肌肌球蛋白抑制剂对 LAS 影响的数据不一致。评估接受 mavacamten 治疗患者 LAS 的变化，并将应变模式与心房颤动（AF）的发生相关联。在开始 mavacamten 治疗后连续获取超声心动图。我们重新测量了二维及多普勒衍生测量值，并获取了应变测量值。我们检查了 LAS 及相关参数的时间变化，包括决定心房前负荷和后负荷的参数，以及影响心房功能的心室变化。我们纳入来自 65 例患者的 434 份超声心动图。治疗 24 周后，左心室流出道压差、整体纵向应变和左心室射血分数均下降。左心房容积指数（p <0.001）、二尖瓣反流严重程度（p = 0.01）和 E/e' 速度（p = 0.01）也下降。LAS 的全部 3 个组分均恶化（p <0.001）。7 例基线 AF 患者出现复发，另有 4 例出现新发 AF。作为时间依赖性变量，LAS 可预测 AF。接受 mavacamten 治疗时观察到的 LAS 下降可能是其他血流动力学参数改变、心房功能减退或两者共同作用的下游效应。因此，LAS 降低可能代表对左心房的有害效应，或代表其他变化的中性副产物，尽管 LAS 与 AF 之间的关联值得注意，并可能突显应变测量在该人群中的预后意义。

Case Report: Radiological-Pathological Correlation of Ectopic Pancreatic Tissue as Anterior Mediastinal Mass
summary: Ectopic pancreatic tissue presenting as large anterior mediastinal mass is exceedingly rare and poses a significant diagnostic challenge, which could mimic common malignancies such as thymoma, teratoma or lymphoma. We report a case of a 49-year-old female who presented with pleuritic chest pain, new-onset atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response and nonsustained ventricular tachycardia. Computer tomography pulmonary angiogram (CTPA) identified a large peripherally enhancing anterior mediastinal mass with extensive central necrosis. The lesion exerted a significant mass effect, compressing the pulmonary trunk and displacing the ascending aorta. Initial CT-guided core biopsy was nondiagnostic, yielding only necrotic debris and neutrophils. Given the diagnostic uncertainty and the patient's worsening symptoms, a surgical biopsy via a Chamberlain procedure was performed, revealing thick, black necrotic fluid with histology confirming ectopic pancreatic tissue. This case demonstrates ectopic pancreatic tissue as a rare differential of a necrotic anterior mediastinal mass. Early recognition is vital to guide appropriate surgical management and prevent morbidity related to pancreatic enzymatic action on surrounding key anatomical structures and the misdiagnosis of more common mediastinal neoplasms.

AI.tldr: 49岁女性以新发快速心室率房颤和非持续性室速就诊，前纵隔坏死性肿块经手术活检证实为异位胰腺组织。
AI.motivation: 异位胰腺组织表现为前纵隔大肿块极为罕见，影像上可模仿胸腺瘤、畸胎瘤或淋巴瘤等常见恶性肿瘤，诊断困难；既往证据多为个案，缺乏明确识别路径。
AI.method: 个案报告，单例49岁女性；因胸膜炎性胸痛、新发快速心室率房颤及非持续性室速评估。CT肺动脉造影显示前纵隔周边强化、中央广泛坏死的大肿块，压迫肺动脉干并推移升主动脉。先行CT引导粗针活检仅见坏死碎屑和中性粒细胞，后经Chamberlain手术活检行组织学确诊。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计方法、终点定义或随访数据。
AI.result: CT引导粗针活检未能诊断；手术活检见厚、黑色坏死液体，组织学证实为异位胰腺组织。摘要未报告定量效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 异位胰腺组织应纳入坏死性前纵隔肿块的罕见鉴别诊断；早期识别有助于指导合适的外科处理，避免胰腺酶作用于邻近关键解剖结构所致并发症，并减少误诊为常见纵隔肿瘤。局限性为单例个案报告，摘要未报告治疗结局与随访。

summary_zh: 异位胰腺组织表现为大的前纵隔肿块极为罕见，并构成重大诊断挑战，可模仿胸腺瘤、畸胎瘤或淋巴瘤等常见恶性肿瘤。我们报告一例49岁女性，表现为胸膜性胸痛、新发心房颤动伴快速心室率以及非持续性室性心动过速。计算机断层扫描肺血管造影（CTPA）发现一个大的、周边强化的前纵隔肿块，伴广泛中央坏死。该病变产生显著占位效应，压迫肺动脉干并使升主动脉移位。初始CT引导下空心针活检无诊断价值，仅获得坏死碎屑和中性粒细胞。鉴于诊断不确定且患者症状加重，行经Chamberlain手术的外科活检，发现浓稠的黑色坏死性液体，组织学证实为异位胰腺组织。本病例表明异位胰腺组织是坏死性前纵隔肿块的一种罕见鉴别诊断。早期识别对于指导恰当的外科处理、预防与胰腺酶作用于周围关键解剖结构相关的并发症，以及避免将更常见的纵隔肿瘤误诊至关重要。

title: Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Effectiveness End Points, Safety End Points, and Trial Design: Academic Research Consortium Initiative Endorsed by the Heart Rhythm Society.
summary: The aim of the AFA-ARC (Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Academic Research Consortium) initiative is to reexamine trial design and the safety and effectiveness end points for pivotal clinical trials evaluating catheter ablation for the treatment of symptomatic atrial fibrillation to provide meaningful and interpretable data to support regulatory decision-making. Beginning in July 2024, a group of international experts began meeting regularly both virtually together and separately in working groups (group 1 effectiveness end points; group 2 safety end points; and group 3 trial design and report forms), with one in-person meeting held in April 2025, and revisions of draft proposals from January 2025 to February 2026. The Food and Drug Administration Office of Cardiovascular Devices at the Center for Devices and Radiological Health provided input throughout the revision and proposal process. A patient advocate participated in the in-person meeting and during the revision phase. Heart Rhythm Society leadership was involved throughout the process and in the revision phase. Industry representatives were sent drafts of the proposed manuscripts during the revision phase before submission. The result of this process was the creation of a combined document to reexamine trial design and the safety and effectiveness end points for pivotal clinical trials evaluating catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation. This document represents contributions from each of the 3 Working Groups. The Heart Rhythm Society endorsed this document. This AFA-ARC document proposes revised effectiveness and safety end points, study design, and report forms for studies evaluating AF ablation in patients with symptomatic paroxysmal, persistent, or longstanding persistent AF.

AI.tldr: AFA-ARC 国际学术研究联盟发布并经 HRS 认可的共识文件，重新界定症状性房颤导管消融关键性临床试验的有效性终点、安全性终点、试验设计与报告表，以支持监管决策。
AI.motivation: 评估导管消融治疗症状性房颤的关键性临床试验，其有效性终点与安全性终点缺乏统一、可解释的定义，导致不同研究结果难以横向比较，也难以为器械与技术的监管审批提供一致性证据。AFA-ARC  initiative 旨在系统重新审视试验设计与终点体系，向监管机构输出有意义、可解读的数据。
AI.method: 本研究为专家共识/方法学文件，非临床试验。2024 年 7 月起组建国际专家组，分设 3 个工作组（①有效性终点、②安全性终点、③试验设计与报告表），定期召开线上会议及分组会议，2025 年 4 月举行 1 次线下会议，2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 2 月对草案进行修订。美国 FDA 器械与放射健康中心心血管器械办公室全程提供意见，1 名患者代表参加线下会议及修订阶段，HRS 领导层全程参与，企业代表在投稿前收到草案文本。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义细节及统计方法。
AI.result: 最终产出为一份整合 3 个工作组贡献的合并文件，提出针对症状性阵发性、持续性及长程持续性房颤患者消融研究修订后的有效性终点、安全性终点、研究设计与报告表，并获得 HRS 认可。摘要未报告任何定量数据、具体终点定义条目或推荐等级。
AI.conclusion: 该文件为房颤消融关键性试验提供统一的终点与设计框架，有望提升研究之间的可比性及监管决策的可解释性。局限性在于其为共识性方法学文件，缺乏实证数据支撑，具体推荐内容与实施后的效果评价摘要均未报告，尚需在后续试验与注册研究中检验其可行性与接受度。

title: Optimal duration of anticoagulation after successful catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: insights from recent randomized trials
Oxidative Stress and Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is the most common arrhythmia after cardiac surgery and is linked to higher mortality and hospitalizations. Oxidative injury may contribute to its development; therefore, we aimed to systematically evaluate the relationship between oxidative stress biomarkers and POAF. MEDLINE, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to August 2026 for studies reporting oxidative stress biomarkers and POAF in adults undergoing cardiac surgery. Altogether, 31 studies (4,983 patients) were included; most were at high risk of bias by QUIPS assessment. We pooled similar studies using random-effects meta-analysis, compared associations between atrial and circulating measurements using a three-level model with cluster-robust inference, and summarized the remaining studies by effect direction. Pooled POAF incidence was 30.4% (95% CI 27.4 to 33.5). Atrial oxidative stress biomarkers were higher in patients who developed POAF (Hedges g 0.89, 95% CI 0.45 to 1.32), but blood levels of the same biomarker showed no statistical significance (g 0.13, 95% CI -0.04 to 0.30; between-compartment difference of 0.76, p = 0.005). Among individual markers, preoperative malondialdehyde differed only modestly between groups, while circulating markers increased postoperatively. Atrial oxidase and pericardial myeloperoxidase activity showed the largest adjusted associations with POAF. Oxidative-stress associations with POAF depend on sampling site and timing. Atrial tissue measures show stronger associations than preoperative blood biomarkers, while early postoperative pericardial and circulating markers may reflect reperfusion injury. Because the evidence is heterogeneous, standardized prospective studies are needed to validate these biomarkers and determine their clinical utility.

AI.tldr: 在31项研究、4983例心脏手术患者中，术后房颤（POAF）发生率为30.4%；心房组织氧化应激标志物与POAF的关联明显强于外周血标志物（组间差异0.76，P=0.005）。
AI.motivation: POAF是心脏手术后最常见的心律失常，与死亡率和再住院率升高相关。氧化损伤被认为可能参与其发生机制，但既往研究多为小样本、采样部位（心房组织与外周血）和采样时间不统一，导致标志物与POAF的关联强度不明。本研究系统评价氧化应激生物标志物与POAF的关系，并比较不同采样部位的结果差异。
AI.method: 系统评价与荟萃分析。检索MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane Library（自建库至2026年8月），纳入报告成人心脏手术后氧化应激标志物与POAF关系的研究。最终纳入31项研究、共4983例患者，多数研究经QUIPS评估为高偏倚风险。对同类研究采用随机效应模型合并；对心房组织与外周血测量结果，采用三水平模型加聚类稳健推断进行比较；其余无法合并的研究按效应方向进行归纳。主要观察指标为POAF发生率及氧化应激标志物与POAF的关联强度（Hedges g）。
AI.result: 合并POAF发生率为30.4%（95% CI 27.4–33.5）。发生POAF的患者心房组织氧化应激标志物水平更高（Hedges g 0.89，95% CI 0.45–1.32），而同一标志物的血液水平与POAF无统计学显著关联（g 0.13，95% CI -0.04–0.30），两种采样部位间的差异为0.76（P=0.005）。在单个标志物中，术前丙二醛（MDA）在两组间差异仅较小，而循环标志物在术后升高；心房氧化酶活性和心包液髓过氧化物酶（MPO）活性与POAF的校正后关联最强。
AI.conclusion: 氧化应激与POAF的关联取决于采样部位和采样时间：心房组织测量的关联强于术前血液标志物，而术后早期心包液和循环标志物可能更多反映再灌注损伤而非房颤发生机制。由于纳入研究异质性大、整体偏倚风险高，上述发现尚不足以支持将氧化应激标志物用于临床风险分层，需标准化、前瞻性研究进一步验证其预测价值和临床效用。

summary_zh: 术后心房颤动（POAF）是心脏外科手术后最常见的心律失常，与更高的死亡率和住院率相关。氧化性损伤可能参与其发生；因此，我们旨在系统评价氧化应激生物标志物与POAF之间的关系。检索MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane Library自建库至2026年8月的文献，纳入报告接受心脏外科手术的成人氧化应激生物标志物与POAF关系的研究。共纳入31项研究（4,983例患者）；根据QUIPS评估，多数研究存在高偏倚风险。我们采用随机效应meta分析对同类研究进行合并，并使用带聚类稳健推断的三水平模型比较心房测量与循环测量之间的关联，同时按效应方向对其余研究进行归纳总结。合并的POAF发生率为30.4%（95% CI 27.4～33.5）。发生POAF的患者其心房氧化应激生物标志物水平更高（Hedges g 0.89，95% CI 0.45～1.32），但同一生物标志物的血液水平差异无统计学意义（g 0.13，95% CI -0.04～0.30；两个采样部位的差异为0.76，p = 0.005）。在各单一标志物中，术前丙二醛在两组间差异仅为中等程度，而循环标志物在术后升高。心房氧化酶和心包髓过氧化物酶活性与POAF的校正关联最强。氧化应激与POAF的关联取决于采样部位和采样时间。心房组织测量比术前血液生物标志物显示出更强的关联，而术后早期心包和循环标志物可能反映再灌注损伤。由于证据存在异质性，需要标准化的前瞻性研究来验证这些生物标志物并确定其临床实用性。

title: Antithrombotic Therapy in Patients with Chronic Coronary Disease on Anticoagulation: Evidence from Contemporary Trials
summary: Introduction Chronic coronary disease (CCD) commonly coexists with long-term oral anticoagulation (OAC), particularly for atrial fibrillation (AF). Combination antiplatelet therapy increases bleeding, whereas ischemic protection with OAC alone remains a concern. We critically appraised contemporary evidence and guidelines to define optimal long-term maintenance therapy.Methods We synthesized WOEST, PIONEER AF-PCI, RE-DUAL PCI, AUGUSTUS, AFIRE, OAC-ALONE, PRAEDO-AF, EPIC-CAD, AQUATIC, and meta-analyses. Because foundational trials included recent ACS/PCI populations, evidence was analyzed as early/recent ACS or PCI (≤1 year) and late/stable CAD (>1 year post-PCI or non-revascularized CCD). Designs, populations, ischemic, bleeding, and mortality outcomes were systematically compared within the 2023 ACC/AHA CCD and AF guidelines.Results and discussion Early trials supported aspirin withdrawal and DOAC plus single P2Y12 inhibition after PCI. Later trials showed full-dose OAC monotherapy was noninferior to OAC plus single antiplatelet therapy beyond 6-12 months or in stable non-revascularized CCD for preventing myocardial infarction, stroke, and systemic embolism, while reducing major and clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding and, sometimes, mortality. Prevalence and associated factors of frailty in hospitalized elderly patients with heart failure.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Frailty is frequently observed in elderly hospitalized patients with heart failure. Recognizing its prevalence and associated factors is essential for early identification and may help reduce socioeconomic burdens. This study aimed to assess the prevalence, clinical features, and correlates of frailty in this population.

METHODS: This single-center cross-sectional study enrolled consecutive hospitalized patients aged≥60 years with heart failure from January 2023 to December 2023. According to the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS), patients were classified into three groups: non-frailty (CFS 1-4), mild-to-moderate frailty (CFS 5-6), and severe frailty (CFS 7). Clinical characteristics were compared across groups using comprehensive geriatric assessment data and auxiliary examination results. A multivariable partial proportional odds model (PPOM) was employed to identify factors associated with frailty severity.

RESULTS: A total of 298 elderly patients with heart failure were enrolled, including 149 males (50.0%). The age of the subjects ranged from 60 to 101 years, with a median of 83 years. Amongst them, 234 (78.5%) were identified as having frailty, of whom 192 (82.1%) presented with mild-to-moderate frailty. Statistically significant differences were observed among the three groups in age, weight, body mass index, comorbidity status, activities of daily living, instrumental activities of daily living, mini-nutritional assessment short-form, short physical performance battery, performance-oriented mobility assessment, dominant calf circumference, grip strength, B-type natriuretic peptide, left ventricular ejection fraction (all P < 0.05). No statistically significant differences were found among the three groups in sex, height, hypertension, diabetes, coronary artery disease, arrhythmia, malnutrition, electrocardiographic abnormality grade (including atrial fibrillation, high voltage, T-wave changes, and ST-segment changes), or echocardiographic abnormality grade (including left heart enlargement and pulmonary hypertension) (all P > 0.05). Multivariate PPOM analysis indicated that comorbidity status, mini-nutritional assessment short-form, short physical performance battery, and left ventricular ejection fraction were significant associated factors for frailty in elderly patients with heart failure (all P < 0.05).

CONCLUSIONS: Hospitalized patients with heart failure show a high prevalence of frailty. Comorbidities, poor nutritional status (lower MNA-SF score), impaired physical function (lower SPPB score), and reduced LVEF are important correlates of frailty severity in these patients.

title: Temporal Association Between Exercise and Arrhythmia Episodes in Endurance Athletes With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a prevalent arrhythmia in endurance athletes, and many athletes report exercise as a trigger for AF episodes. We aimed to investigate the association between exercise sessions and arrhythmia episodes in endurance athletes with paroxysmal AF.

METHODS: In endurance athletes diagnosed with paroxysmal AF, we continuously monitored arrhythmia episodes using insertable cardiac monitors and report event rates per 24 hours and temporal relation of arrhythmias with exercise sessions. Sports watches and chest straps were used for exercise monitoring. Exercise with a heart rate of 76% to 84% and ≥ 85% of the individual maximum heart rate was classified as high and very high intensity, respectively.

RESULTS: Forty-seven athletes (age 57±10, range 33-75 years, 3 women) were monitored with insertable cardiac monitors for a total of 55 994 hours (median 1008 [840-1344] equaling 42 days [35-56]) and performed a total of 1722 hours of exercise, of which 592 hours at high or very high intensity. Thirty-one athletes (66%) had a total of 1445 (median 17 [3-33]) AF episodes during monitoring. Thirteen athletes (27%) had AF during exercise of whom 2 had AF during high-intensity sessions. The event rate of AF was not higher during (0.34 per 24 hours [95% CI, 0.13-0.65]) or subsequently following an exercise session (0.37 [95% CI, 0.10-0.71]), compared with unrelated to exercise (>3 hours after, 0.61 [95% CI, 0.26-1.13]). There were no episodes of exercise-related ventricular tachycardia.

CONCLUSIONS: In this study on endurance athletes with paroxysmal AF, the rate of AF episodes was not increased during or subsequently following exercise sessions.

title: Echocardiographic Left Atrial Volumetric-mechanical Coupling Index for Prediction of Atrial Fibrillation after STEMI.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) commonly complicates ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). Conventional echocardiographic measures may incompletely capture left atrial remodeling. The left atrial volumetric-mechanical coupling index (LACI-vm), integrating left atrial volume index (LAVI) and mitral annular a' velocity, emerges as a novel predictor of cardiovascular outcomes. This study evaluated the association between LACI-vm measured during index hospitalization and incident AF after STEMI and its incremental predictive value beyond clinical and echocardiographic variables.

METHODS: Consecutive STEMI patients undergoing primary coronary angiography from 2017-2023 were retrospectively analyzed. LACI-vm was calculated as LAVI/a'. Patients with prior AF/flutter, non-sinus rhythm during echocardiography, or significant structural heart disease were excluded. Multivariable Cox regression, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, and net reclassification improvement (NRI) were performed.

RESULTS: Among 469 patients (64.5 ± 12.5 years, 24.9% female), median LACI-vm was 3.4 (IQR 2.6-4.9). During a median 56-month follow-up (2,193 person-years), 66 patients (14.1%) developed AF, with an incidence rate of 30.1 per 1,000 person-years. AF incidence was higher with LACI-vm >3.4 than ≤3.4 (23.9% vs. 4.3%, 58.0 vs. 8.1 per 1,000 person-years). LACI-vm independently predicted AF (HR 2.73, 95% CI 1.33-5.64, p=0.006). ROC analysis showed an AUC of 0.857; a cutoff of 4.27 yielded 81% sensitivity and 91% specificity. LACI-vm was not independently associated with mortality. NRI demonstrated improved AF prediction (0.170-0.175, all p<0.001).

CONCLUSIONS: LACI-vm independently predicts post-STEMI AF and may identify patients who could benefit from intensified rhythm monitoring after discharge.

AI.tldr: 在469例STEMI患者中，LACI-vm可独立预测随访期新发AF，ROC曲线下面积0.857，并改善风险分层。
AI.motivation: STEMI后AF常见且与不良预后相关，但常规超声指标对左心房重构的刻画不完整；由左心房容积指数（LAVI）与二尖瓣环a'速度整合而成的LACI-vm在STEMI后AF预测中的价值尚不明确，尤其缺乏其在临床及超声变量之外增量预测能力的研究。
AI.method: 回顾性连续纳入2017—2023年接受直接冠状动脉造影的STEMI患者469例，排除既往AF/房扑、超声时非窦性心律及显著结构性心脏病。LACI-vm=LAVI/a'。主要终点为索引住院后新发AF；采用多变量Cox回归、ROC分析及净重分类改善（NRI）评估独立预测价值与增量预测能力。

背景：心房颤动（AF）常并发于ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）。常规超声心动图指标可能无法完全反映左心房重构。左心房容积-机械耦联指数（LACI-vm）整合左心房容积指数（LAVI）与二尖瓣环a'速度，已成为心血管结局的新型预测指标。本研究评估了首次住院期间测得的LACI-vm与STEMI后新发AF之间的关联，以及其在临床和超声心动图变量之外的增量预测价值。

title: Thromboembolic and Mortality Risk in Patients with Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft—The TRIP-AF Study
Perceived Social Support in Atrial Fibrillation Care: Implications for Nurse-Led Education and Follow-Up.
summary:
AIM: To describe the level, content and sources of perceived social support among adults with atrial fibrillation, and to identify clinical, lifestyle and care pathway factors associated with perceived support.

DESIGN: A cross-sectional survey design.

METHODS: Data were collected through an online survey disseminated across Finland in 2025 via the Finnish Heart Association's website and social media channels among adults with self-reported atrial fibrillation. Perceived social support was measured using the Social Support for Patients with Atrial Fibrillation Instrument, which assesses informational, emotional, and functional support. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics and separate univariate General Linear Model analyses.

RESULTS: Participants reported low-to-moderate informational, emotional, and functional support. Patient education was received primarily from physicians, whereas nurse-delivered education was uncommon, and more than half of participants reported no scheduled follow-up visits. Informational support was strongest for disease consequences and medication information, while support related to treatment options and follow-up monitoring was lower. Emotional support was mainly received from family and friends, while functional support was stronger for self-monitoring than for medication management and structured follow-up. Ablation treatment was consistently associated with lower perceived support across all domains, whereas scheduled follow-up visits were associated with higher emotional support.

CONCLUSIONS: Perceived social support among adults with atrial fibrillation was uneven and embedded in the formal care pathway. Support gaps were evident in follow-up, nurse-delivered education, medication management, and practical atrial fibrillation-specific self-management.

IMPLICATIONS FOR THE PROFESSION AND/OR PATIENT CARE: Cardiovascular nurses can strengthen atrial fibrillation care by providing structured patient education, emotional support, practical self-management support, and follow-up, particularly after ablation and during long-term care.

IMPACT: This study addresses the limited evidence on perceived social support among adults with atrial fibrillation. The findings suggest that support is unevenly integrated into atrial fibrillation care pathways and that nurse-led education and structured follow-up remain underused. The findings identify opportunities to strengthen atrial fibrillation care.

REPORTING METHOD: The study was reported according to the STROBE guideline for cross-sectional studies.

PATIENT OR PUBLIC CONTRIBUTION: No Patient or Public Contribution.

title: First Latin American retrospective registry of cardiac ablation in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients. A LAHRS registry.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation has been proven as an effective and safe therapy for tachyarrhythmias in pediatric and congenital heart disease (CHD) patients. Although there are international registries on the use of catheter ablation in these populations, none of them include Latin American countries.

OBJECTIVES: To assess the clinical characteristics of pediatric and congenital heart disease patients undergoing catheter ablation procedures. Data obtained includes types of arrhythmias, techniques, success, complications and recurrence rates.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: A descriptive and analytical retrospective observational study was performed. A closed coded online form available for 6 months was used. All electrophysiologists who practice pediatric electrophysiology in Latin America and were identified in a previous LAHSR's survey were invited to participate through Latin American Heart Rhythm Society (LAHRS) electronic media ( https://lahrs.org/ ). Participation was not mandatory, it was not encouraged by any economic or material goods, and an informed consent for the use of the data was required. Consecutive electrophysiological catheter procedures were included in children under 18 years of age or patients with CHD, regardless age, between 2017 and 2021.

RESULTS: Twenty physicians from 8 Latin American countries participated. A total of 1778 procedures were reported, 53% were male, mean age was 12.4 ± 5.1 years and 8.5% had congenital heart disease. An ablation was attempted in 87% of the patients, using a non-irrigated tip radiofrequency catheter in 68% of them, and a 3-D mapping system in 29%. Radiofrequency was the most commonly used energy source in 98% of the cases. The most frequent substrates were accessory pathways in 69.5% (61% were manifest), followed by AV nodal reentry in 16.5% and ectopic atrial tachycardia in 4%. Additionally, there were 3.8% atrial flutter, 3.8% ventricular tachycardias, 1.2% premature ventricular contractions. Ablation was considered acutely successful in 93% of the cases. Mean total procedural time was 92.1 ± 36.8 min and mean total fluoroscopy time was 16.3 ± 9.4 min. Complication rate was 1.8% and included complete AV block in 3 patients (0.2%). No deaths were reported. The recurrence rate was 8.5%.

CONCLUSIONS: In this first exclusively pediatric and congenital heart disease retrospective registry of catheter ablation in Latin America, a high rate of success and low incidence of complications was observed. This is in concordance with previously reported registries from other latitudes, proving that ablation is an effective and safe therapy in this group of patients.

title: Efficacy and Safety of Novel Oral Anticoagulants in Elderly Patients with Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
summary: Adults aged 80 years or older with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) often have competing thromboembolic and bleeding risks, renal impairment, frailty, and dose-selection challenges. This single-center retrospective observational cohort included 202 adults aged 80 years or older who received warfarin (n = 56), edoxaban 60 mg once daily (n = 38), edoxaban 30 mg once daily (n = 41), rivaroxaban 15 mg once daily (n = 35), or rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily (n = 32). Six-month embolic events, International Society on Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) bleeding categories, other adverse reactions, official-label dose concordance, dynamic risk scores, and serial laboratory measurements were evaluated. Exploratory generalized overlap weighting addressed measured treatment-selection differences. Embolic events occurred in 8 patients and ISTH minor bleeding in 21; neither outcome differed significantly among groups (exact p = 0.846 and p = 0.199, respectively). No ISTH major or clinically relevant non-major bleeding occurred. Other adverse reactions differed overall (p = 0.014), but pairwise estimates were imprecise. Of 146 direct oral anticoagulant recipients, 72 (49.3%) received a baseline dose concordant with the prespecified official-label framework, 72 (49.3%) received a lower-than-label dose, and 2 (1.4%) received a higher-than-label dose. Low event counts and marked treatment-selection imbalance prevented conclusions of equivalence, superiority, or greater safety. The findings require confirmation in larger, prospectively defined cohorts with longer follow-up, predefined label-dose criteria, and stronger control of confounding.

AI.result: 6个月内共8例发生栓塞事件、21例发生ISTH轻微出血，各组间均无显著差异（精确P=0.846与P=0.199）；未发生ISTH大出血或临床相关非大出血。其他不良反应总体组间差异有统计学意义（P=0.014），但两两比较估计值不精确。146例DOAC使用者中，72例（49.3%）基线剂量符合预设说明书框架，72例（49.3%）低于说明书剂量，2例（1.4%）高于说明书剂量。摘要未报告栓塞事件与出血事件的具体发生率、风险比及95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 在高龄非瓣膜性房颤患者中，华法林与低剂量艾多沙班、利伐沙班方案在6个月内栓塞与轻微出血方面未见显著差异，但事件数少且治疗选择失衡明显，无法就此得出等效性、优效性或安全性更佳的结论。研究提示该人群DOAC低剂量应用普遍（近半数低于说明书剂量），临床实践中需规范剂量评估；结论尚需更大样本、前瞻性设计、更长随访、预设说明书剂量标准并更严格控制混杂的研究验证。

summary_zh: 80岁及以上合并非瓣膜性心房颤动（NVAF）的成年人常同时面临血栓栓塞与出血风险、肾功能受损、衰弱以及剂量选择方面的难题。这项单中心回顾性观察性队列研究纳入202例80岁及以上的成年人，分别接受华法林（n = 56）、依度沙班60 mg每日一次（n = 38）、依度沙班30 mg每日一次（n = 41）、利伐沙班15 mg每日一次（n = 35）或利伐沙班10 mg每日一次（n = 32）。研究评估了6个月时的栓塞事件、国际血栓与止血学会（ISTH）出血分类、其他不良反应、与官方说明书剂量的符合情况、动态风险评分以及系列实验室检测指标。探索性广义重叠加权用于处理已测量的治疗选择差异。8例患者发生栓塞事件，21例发生ISTH轻微出血；两项结局在各组间均无显著差异（精确p = 0.846和p = 0.199）。未发生ISTH大出血或临床相关非大出血。其他不良反应总体存在差异（p = 0.014），但两两比较的估计值不精确。在146例直接口服抗凝药接受者中，72例（49.3%）的基线剂量与预先设定的官方说明书框架相符，72例（49.3%）使用的剂量低于说明书剂量，2例（1.4%）使用的剂量高于说明书剂量。事件数量少以及治疗选择失衡明显，使得无法得出等效性、优效性或安全性更佳的结论。这些发现需要在样本量更大、前瞻性界定、随访时间更长、采用预先定义的说明书剂量标准并更强力控制混杂因素的队列中加以验证。

title: Effects of Rhythm Control versus Rate Control on Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty Development in Older Patients: Protocol for the Cardioversion of Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty in the Elderly (CAFFE) Study, an Observational, Prospective Cohort Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF), highly prevalent in older individuals, is associated with frailty and disability. AF therapy is based on rhythm control (RhythmC) to restore sinus rhythm or rate control (RateC) to lower the heart rate. Published guidelines do not indicate a preference for one over the other for older people.

OBJECTIVE: This study aims to evaluate whether RhythmC is more effective than RateC in hindering the progression of frailty and disability.

METHODS: The Cardioversion of Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty in the Elderly (CAFFE) study is a prospective, multicenter, observational cohort study that includes 4 groups of patients: (1) adults age 75 years or older undergoing RhythmC treatment; (2) adults aged 65 to 74 years undergoing RhythmC treatment; (3) adults 65 years or older undergoing RateC treatment; and (4) adults 65 years or older without overt chronic conditions as the control group (n=40 in each group). At baseline, all participants will undergo a Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment (CGA) and analyses of inflammation and metabolomics. At home, a device will evaluate each participant's heart rhythm, activity profile, and sleep. After 1 month, the CGA will be repeated.

RESULTS: The CAFFE study was funded as a Research Project of National Interest by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (October 2023). Ethical committee final approval was given in June 2024. In October 2025, the coordinating center had enrolled 31 of 40 patients with AF (mean age 78, SD 9 years; 8 [25.8%] women; mean CHA2DS2-VA score 4.2, SD 1.2; 13 [43.3%] robust participants). All centers are now completing the enrollment (103/160 participants), and the analysis of inflammatory mediators has started. The results are expected to be published in summer 2027.

CONCLUSIONS: The CAFFE study will evaluate the effectiveness of AF management strategies in older patients. If RhythmC can slow the progression of frailty and disability, specific clinical trials should more definitively address this knowledge gap.

AI.tldr: CAFFE 前瞻性多中心队列研究方案拟比较节律控制与心率控制对 65 岁以上房颤患者衰弱与失能进展的影响，目前尚在入组（103/160），结果预计 2027 年发表。
AI.motivation: 房颤在老年人中高度流行，并与衰弱和失能相关；现有指南未对老年患者的节律控制（恢复窦性心律）与心率控制（降低心室率）作出优先推荐，缺乏以衰弱、失能为终点的证据。
AI.method: CAFFE 为前瞻性、多中心、观察性队列研究，设 4 组、每组 n=40：≥75 岁接受节律控制组、65–74 岁节律控制组、≥65 岁心率控制组，以及 ≥65 岁无明确慢性疾病的对照组。基线行老年综合评估（CGA）及炎症因子与代谢组学检测，居家设备监测心律、活动与睡眠，1 个月后复查 CGA；主要终点为衰弱与失能进展，具体定义与统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 研究获意大利大学与研究部国家利益研究项目资助（2023 年 10 月），伦理批准于 2024 年 6 月。截至 2025 年 10 月，协调中心入组房颤患者 31/40（平均年龄 78 岁，SD 9；女性 8 例，25.8%；平均 CHA2DS2-VA 4.2，SD 1.2；体健者 13 例，43.3%）；全中心累计入组 103/160，炎症介质分析已启动。疗效数据尚未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将评估不同房颤管理策略对老年患者衰弱与失能进展的影响；若节律控制可延缓衰弱与失能进展，则需专门临床试验进一步验证。当前仅为方案与入组进展，尚无结局结论，且观察性设计存在选择偏倚与随访时间较短的局限。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）在老年人中高度流行，并与衰弱和失能相关。AF治疗基于节律控制（RhythmC）以恢复窦性心律，或心率控制（RateC）以降低心率。已发表的指南未表明在老年人中应优先选择其中一种策略。

目的：本研究旨在评估RhythmC在阻碍衰弱和失能进展方面是否比RateC更有效。

方法：老年人心房颤动复律与衰弱（CAFFE）研究是一项前瞻性、多中心、观察性队列研究，纳入4组患者：（1）接受RhythmC治疗的75岁及以上成人；（2）接受RhythmC治疗的65至74岁成人；（3）接受RateC治疗的65岁及以上成人；（4）无明显的慢性疾病的65岁及以上成人作为对照组（每组n=40）。在基线时，所有参与者将接受综合老年评估（CGA）以及炎症和代谢组学分析。在家中将使用设备评估每位参与者的心律、活动特征和睡眠。1个月后，将重复CGA。

结果：CAFFE研究由意大利大学与研究部作为国家利益研究项目资助（2023年10月）。伦理委员会于2024年6月给予最终批准。2025年10月，协调中心已入组40例AF患者中的31例（平均年龄78岁，SD 9岁；女性8例[25.8%]；平均CHA2DS2-VA评分4.2，SD 1.2；健壮受试者13例[43.3%]）。所有中心目前正在完成入组（103/160例参与者），炎症介质分析已经开始。结果预计将于2027年夏季发表。

结论：CAFFE研究将评估老年患者AF管理策略的有效性。如果RhythmC能够减缓衰弱和失能的进展，则专门的临床试验应更明确地解决这一知识空白。

title: Multiple Accessory Pathways in Children: Electrophysiological Features and Catheter Ablation Outcomes.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Multiple accessory pathways (MAPs) may complicate electrophysiological assessment and catheter ablation in pediatric patients. We aimed to evaluate the clinical and electrophysiological characteristics, anatomical distribution, and procedural and follow-up outcomes of pediatric patients with MAPs.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study included pediatric patients with at least two distinct accessory pathways identified during EPS between November 2019 and February 2026.

RESULTS: Of 1101 patients who underwent catheter ablation, 619 had accessory pathway-related arrhythmias; among these, 31 (5.0%) had MAPs. The mean age and body weight at the first procedure were 12.1 ± 3.6 years and 44.2 ± 18.8 kg, respectively, and 16 patients were female. Nine patients had structural heart disease, including seven with Ebstein anomaly. A total of 66 accessory pathways were identified: 28 patients had two pathways, two had three, and one had four. The right posteroseptal region was the most common pathway location (27.3%). One patient also had atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia. Complete elimination of all accessory pathways was achieved in 29 of 31 patients (93.5%), and 63 of 66 pathways (95.5%) were successfully ablated. Recurrence occurred in six patients (19.4%). No procedure-related complications were observed during a mean follow-up of 26.3 ± 18.7 months.

CONCLUSION: MAPs were successfully treated with high acute success rates and no procedure-related complications. Nevertheless, recurrence and the identification of additional accessory pathways during subsequent evaluations remained clinically relevant, supporting the need for systematic post-ablation reassessment and long-term follow-up.

AI.tldr: 儿童多旁路患者占旁路相关心律失常消融病例的5.0%，急性完全消融成功率达93.5%（旁路水平95.5%），无手术并发症，但随访期复发率19.4%，提示需系统术后复评与长期随访。
AI.motivation: 多旁路（MAPs）会使儿童电生理检查与导管消融的标测和靶点判定复杂化，既往证据对该人群的电生理特征、旁路解剖分布及术中与随访结局缺乏系统描述，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2019年11月至2026年2月电生理检查中确认存在至少两条独立旁路的儿童患者。以首次手术时年龄、体重、结构性心脏病合并情况、旁路数目与解剖分布为描述指标；终点为全部旁路完全消融（患者水平与旁路水平）、随访期复发及手术相关并发症，随访时间以均值±标准差表示；摘要未报告具体统计检验方法及效应量置信区间。
AI.result: 共1101例患儿接受导管消融，其中619例为旁路相关心律失常，31例（5.0%）存在多旁路。首次手术平均年龄12.1±3.6岁，体重44.2±18.8 kg，女性16例；9例合并结构性心脏病，其中7例为Ebstein畸形。共识别66条旁路：28例有2条、2例有3条、1例有4条；右后间隔区最常见（27.3%）；1例合并房室结折返性心动过速。患者水平完全消融29/31例（93.5%），旁路水平成功消融63/66条（95.5%）。随访（平均26.3±18.7个月）期间6例（19.4%）复发，未观察到手术相关并发症。各终点比较的P值与95%置信区间摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 儿童多旁路可经导管消融获得较高的急性成功率且无手术并发症，但约五分之一的患者出现复发，且后续评估中新旁路仍可被识别，具有临床意义。提示对儿童多旁路患者应在术后进行系统的电生理再评估并坚持长期随访；本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量小（31例），结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
背景：多发性旁路（multiple accessory pathways，MAPs）可能使儿童患者的电生理评估和导管消融变得更加复杂。本研究旨在评估多发性旁路患儿的临床与电生理特征、解剖分布，以及手术和随访结局。

材料与方法：本回顾性研究纳入2019年11月至2026年2月期间在电生理检查（EPS）中识别出至少两条明确旁路的儿童患者。

结果：在1101例接受导管消融的患者中，619例存在旁路相关心律失常；其中31例（5.0%）存在多发性旁路。首次手术时的平均年龄和体重分别为12.1 ± 3.6岁和44.2 ± 18.8 kg，其中16例为女性。9例患者存在结构性心脏病，包括7例Ebstein畸形。共识别出66条旁路：28例患者有两条旁路，2例有三条，1例有四条。右后间隔区是最常见的旁路位置（27.3%）。1例患者还合并房室结折返性心动过速。31例患者中有29例（93.5%）实现了所有旁路的完全消除，66条旁路中有63条（95.5%）成功消融。6例患者（19.4%）出现复发。在平均26.3 ± 18.7个月的随访期间，未观察到手术相关并发症。

结论：多发性旁路可获得较高的急性成功率和无手术相关并发症的治疗结果。然而，复发以及在后续评估中发现额外旁路仍具有临床意义，这支持有必要进行系统性的消融后重新评估和长期随访。

title: Long-Term Outcomes of AV Node Ablation Plus CRT Compared to AF Catheter Ablation in Patients With AF and HFrEF
summary: Background Catheter ablation is an established rhythm-control strategy for atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), while atrioventricular node ablation with cardiac resynchronization therapy (AVNA+CRT) is often used in older patients with advanced disease when durable rhythm control is less feasible. Comparative long-term outcomes remain unclear.Methods Using the TriNetX Research Network, we identified adults with HFrEF and AF from 2016 who underwent AF ablation or AVNA+CRT from 2016-2023 and 2016-2020 for the 2- and 5-year analysis, respectively. Propensity score matching was performed separately using 58 prespecified covariates. Outcomes included embolic events (stroke/systemic embolism), all-cause mortality, heart failure (HF) hospitalization, and heart transplant/left ventricular assist device (LVAD) implantation.Results The 2-year cohort included 16,276 patients (2899 AVNA+CRT; 13,377 AF ablation); the 5-year cohort included 7370 patients (1463 AVNA+CRT; 5907 AF Ablation). After matching, AVNA+CRT was associated with higher all-cause mortality (RR 1.580, 95% CI 1.389-1.799), HF hospitalization (RR 1.106, 95% CI 1.040-1.176), and heart transplant/LVAD implantation (RR 2.381, 95% CI 1.142-4.975), with no difference in embolic events at 2 years. At 5 years, AVNA+CRT remained associated with higher mortality (RR 1.350, 95% CI 1.198-1.522; p < 0.001), while HF hospitalization, embolic events, and heart transplant/LVAD implantation did not differ significantly.Conclusion In a large propensity matched HFrEF-AF cohort, AVNA+CRT was associated with higher mortality at 2 and 5 years than AF ablation, with excess HF hospitalization and transplant/LVAD at 2 years, whereas HF hospitalization rates were similar at 5 years. Prospective studies are needed to refine patient selection in older, medically complex patients.

AI.tldr: 在倾向性匹配的 HFrEF 合并 AF 大型队列中，房室结消融联合 CRT 相比 AF 导管消融的 2 年与 5 年全因死亡风险更高（RR 1.580 与 1.350），2 年时心衰住院及心脏移植/LVAD 亦更多。
AI.motivation: AF 合并 HFrEF 患者中，导管消融已是确立的节律控制策略；而房室结消融联合 CRT（AVNA+CRT）多用于年龄更大、病情更重、难以实现持久节律控制者。两种策略的长期比较证据缺乏，临床选择缺少依据，本研究即针对这一缺口开展大规模比较。
AI.method: 基于 TriNetX Research Network 的回顾性队列研究。纳入 2016 年起诊断为 HFrEF 合并 AF 的成人，AF 消融组与 AVNA+CRT 组分别于 2016–2023 年（2 年分析）和 2016–2020 年（5 年分析）接受手术。2 年队列 16,276 例（AVNA+CRT 2899 例，AF 消融 13,377 例）；5 年队列 7370 例（1463 例 vs 5907 例）。采用 58 项预设协变量分别进行倾向性评分匹配。终点包括栓塞事件（卒中/系统性栓塞）、全因死亡、心衰住院、心脏移植或 LVAD 植入；以风险比（RR）及 95%CI 比较。
AI.result: 匹配后，2 年时 AVNA+CRT 组全因死亡（RR 1.580，95%CI 1.389–1.799）、心衰住院（RR 1.106，95%CI 1.040–1.176）、心脏移植/LVAD 植入（RR 2.381，95%CI 1.142–4.975）均高于 AF 消融组，栓塞事件无差异（摘要未报告具体数值）。5 年时 AVNA+CRT 组死亡风险仍更高（RR 1.350，95%CI 1.198–1.522；P<0.001），其中心衰住院、栓塞事件与心脏移植/LVAD 植入均无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 在这一大规模倾向性匹配的 HFrEF-AF 队列中，AVNA+CRT 与 AF 消融相比 2 年和 5 年全因死亡率均更高，2 年时心衰住院与移植/LVAD 亦更多，但 5 年时心衰住院率两组相近。结果提示对高龄、合并症多的患者应更审慎地选择“消融+CRT”策略；但本研究为回顾性登记数据分析，存在残余混杂与选择偏倚（AVNA+CRT 组本身病情更重、年龄更大），且摘要未报告年龄、LVEF、随访完整性及栓塞事件具体数据，仍需前瞻性研究细化人群选择。

summary_zh:
背景：导管消融是心房颤动（AF）合并射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者已确立的节律控制策略，而房室结消融联合心脏再同步治疗（AVNA+CRT）常用于病情晚期、持久节律控制可行性较低的老年患者。两者的长期结局比较仍不明确。

方法：利用TriNetX Research Network，我们筛选了2016年起患有HFrEF和AF的成人，这些患者分别在2016-2023年和2016-2020年接受AF消融或AVNA+CRT，以分别进行2年和5年分析。使用58个预设协变量分别进行倾向性评分匹配。结局包括栓塞事件（卒中/系统性栓塞）、全因死亡、心力衰竭（HF）住院以及心脏移植/左心室辅助装置（LVAD）植入。

结果：2年队列包括16,276例患者（AVNA+CRT 2899例；AF消融13,377例）；5年队列包括7370例患者（AVNA+CRT 1463例；AF消融5907例）。匹配后，AVNA+CRT与更高的全因死亡（RR 1.580，95% CI 1.389-1.799）、HF住院（RR 1.106，95% CI 1.040-1.176）以及心脏移植/LVAD植入（RR 2.381，95% CI 1.142-4.975）相关，2年时栓塞事件无差异。5年时，AVNA+CRT仍与更高的死亡风险相关（RR 1.350，95% CI 1.198-1.522；p < 0.001），而HF住院、栓塞事件和心脏移植/LVAD植入无显著差异。

结论：在一个大型倾向性匹配的HFrEF-AF队列中，与AF消融相比，AVNA+CRT与2年和5年时更高的死亡风险相关，并在2年时伴有更多的HF住院和移植/LVAD；而5年时HF住院率相似。需要前瞻性研究来优化老年、医学情况复杂患者的筛选。

title: Pulmonary Vein Stenosis Following Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation Presenting With Massive Pleural Effusion: A Case Report
summary: We report a rare case of pulmonary vein stenosis (PVS) presenting with massive pleural effusion 5 months after radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA) for atrial fibrillation. A 58-year-old woman developed persistent fever, cough, and left lower lobe consolidation with a large pleural effusion. Initial antibiotic therapy was ineffective. Three-dimensional computed tomography (3D-CT) revealed severe stenosis of the left inferior pulmonary vein. Following balloon angioplasty, both pulmonary consolidation and pleural effusion resolved. Because PVS may present with nonspecific findings and delayed onset, it should be considered in patients with unexplained pulmonary infiltrates or pleural effusion after RFCA.

AI.tldr: 58 岁女性在房颤射频消融术后 5 个月出现以大量胸腔积液为表现的左肺下静脉重度狭窄，经球囊扩张后肺部病变与积液均消退。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉狭窄（PVS）是房颤射频消融术后的少见但严重并发症，临床表现缺乏特异性，且可延迟至术后数月才出现；若缺乏对本病的警觉，容易被误诊为感染性肺炎或胸腔积液并接受无效的抗生素治疗。既往对以大量胸腔积液为首发或主要表现的 PVS 报道极少，本例旨在提示消融术后随访中识别这一非典型表现的重要性。
AI.method: 个案报道（单例）。研究对象为 1 例 58 岁女性，既往因心房颤动接受射频导管消融（RFCA）。术后 5 个月出现持续发热、咳嗽、左下叶肺实变伴大量胸腔积液。初始抗生素治疗无效。影像学采用三维 CT（3D-CT）评估肺静脉，确诊为左肺下静脉重度狭窄。干预为狭窄静脉球囊扩张成形术。观察终点为临床症状、肺部实变及胸腔积液的转归。摘要未报告定量测量值、狭窄程度分级数值及随访时长。
AI.result: 初始抗生素治疗无效；3D-CT 显示左肺下静脉重度狭窄。行球囊扩张成形术后，肺部实变与胸腔积液均消退。摘要未报告狭窄直径、跨狭窄压差、手术成功率的量化指标及随访影像学时间点，也未报告 P 值或置信区间。
AI.conclusion: PVS 可在 RFCA 术后延迟发生，并以持续发热、肺实变和大量胸腔积液等非特异性表现为主，抗生素治疗无效时应高度怀疑本病；3D-CT 有助于明确诊断，球囊扩张成形术可逆转肺部改变。临床意义在于：对房颤消融术后出现不明原因肺部浸润影或胸腔积液的患者，应尽早行肺静脉影像学评估，以免延误诊治。局限性为单个病例报道，缺乏发生率、长期通畅率及与其他治疗方式（如支架植入）比较的证据。

summary_zh: 我们报告一例罕见病例：肺静脉狭窄（PVS）在因心房颤动行射频导管消融（RFCA）后5个月表现为大量胸腔积液。一名58岁女性出现持续发热、咳嗽，以及伴大量胸腔积液的左下叶实变。初始抗生素治疗无效。三维计算机断层扫描（3D-CT）显示左下肺静脉严重狭窄。球囊血管成形术后，肺部实变和胸腔积液均消退。由于PVS可表现为非特异性发现且起病延迟，对于RFCA后出现不明原因肺部浸润影或胸腔积液的患者，应考虑该诊断。

title: Relationship between Positional Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Excessive Daytime Sleepiness in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
PURPOSE: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is highly prevalent in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). Prior studies suggest that excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS), a common symptom of OSA, is less pronounced in patients with AF. This study focused on a subtype of OSA, positional OSA (POSA), and examined its association with EDS overall and separately in patients with and without AF.

METHODS: This study included 222 OSA patients with and without AF history who underwent in-lab polysomnography. POSA was defined using three criteria: conventional POSA (cPOSA; supine/non-supine apnea-hypopnea index [AHI] ratio ≥ 2), intermediately conservative POSA (iPOSA; supine/non-supine AHI ratio ≥ 3), and exclusive POSA (ePOSA; supine/non-supine AHI ratio ≥ 2 and non-supine AHI < 5 events/h). EDS was determined by an Epworth Sleepiness Scale score ≥ 11. Logistic regression was performed to assess the associations.

RESULTS: Overall, 55.4% of patients had cPOSA, and 43.6% reported EDS. Analysis of the entire cohort showed that patients with cPOSA (adjusted odds ratio [aOR]: 0.51, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.26-0.98) or iPOSA (aOR: 0.37, 95% CI: 0.18-0.74) had lower odds of EDS than their non-POSA counterparts. Among patients with AF, cPOSA was associated with lower odds of EDS (aOR: 0.32, 95% CI: 0.11-0.90). Among patients without AF, iPOSA was associated with lower odds of EDS (aOR: 0.28, 95% CI: 0.10-0.75).

CONCLUSION: The association between POSA and EDS varied by POSA definitions and AF status. The findings suggest that EDS manifests differently by cPOSA status in patients with AF.

AI.tldr: 在222例接受实验室多导睡眠监测的OSA患者中，体位性OSA（POSA）与日间过度嗜睡（EDS）呈负相关；这种关联随POSA定义和是否合并AF而不同，合并AF者中cPOSA与EDS风险降低相关（aOR 0.32）。
AI.motivation: OSA在房颤（AF）患者中高度流行，而既往研究提示AF患者的日间过度嗜睡（EDS）症状不如非AF患者明显，即症状与呼吸事件严重程度不匹配，可能导致漏诊。POSA是OSA的一种亚型，其与EDS的关系此前研究较少，且在AF与非AF人群中是否存在差异尚不清楚。本研究即针对这一证据缺口，分析POSA与EDS的关联。
AI.method: 单中心横断面研究，纳入222例经实验室多导睡眠监测确诊的OSA患者（合并或不合并AF病史），样本量222例。POSA按三种标准定义：常规POSA（cPOSA，仰卧位与非仰卧位AHI比值≥2）、中保守POSA（iPOSA，比值≥3）、严格POSA（ePOSA，比值≥2且非仰卧位AHI<5次/h）。EDS定义为Epworth嗜睡量表评分≥11分。采用logistic回归评估POSA与EDS的关联，并分别在全队列及AF、非AF亚组中分析；校正变量、各亚组样本量及ePOSA的结果摘要均未报告。
AI.result: 全队列中55.4%符合cPOSA，43.6%存在EDS。全队列分析显示，cPOSA（校正OR 0.51，95%CI 0.26–0.98）与iPOSA（校正OR 0.37，95%CI 0.18–0.74）患者发生EDS的比值均低于非POSA者。亚组分析中，合并AF患者中cPOSA与EDS风险降低相关（校正OR 0.32，95%CI 0.11–0.90）；非AF患者中iPOSA与EDS风险降低相关（校正OR 0.28，95%CI 0.10–0.75）。ePOSA定义下的结果摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: POSA与EDS的关联取决于所用POSA定义及患者是否合并AF：在AF人群中，仰卧位依赖性呼吸事件（cPOSA）者报告的嗜睡更轻。这提示AF患者的OSA症状评估可能低估其实际呼吸事件负荷，临床上对AF患者不应仅凭ESS评分决定是否筛查或治疗OSA，应结合多导睡眠监测结果。局限性包括横断面设计无法推断因果、亚组样本量较小、校正变量与ePOSA结果未在摘要中报告，需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）在房颤（AF）患者中高度流行。既往研究提示，日间过度嗜睡（EDS）作为OSA的常见症状，在AF患者中较不明显。本研究聚焦于OSA的一种亚型——体位性OSA（POSA），并总体以及在伴和不伴AF的患者中分别检验其与EDS的关联。

方法：本研究纳入222例有或无AF病史并接受实验室多导睡眠监测的OSA患者。POSA采用三项标准定义：传统POSA（cPOSA；仰卧位/非仰卧位呼吸暂停低通气指数[AHI]比值≥2）、中间型保守POSA（iPOSA；仰卧位/非仰卧位AHI比值≥3）和排他性POSA（ePOSA；仰卧位/非仰卧位AHI比值≥2且非仰卧位AHI<5次/小时）。EDS由Epworth嗜睡量表评分≥11确定。采用logistic回归评估这些关联。

结果：总体而言，55.4%的患者患有cPOSA，43.6%报告EDS。整个队列分析显示，与无POSA患者相比，cPOSA（校正比值比[aOR]：0.51，95%置信区间[CI]：0.26-0.98）或iPOSA（aOR：0.37，95%CI：0.18-0.74）患者的EDS比值较低。在AF患者中，cPOSA与较低的EDS比值相关（aOR：0.32，95%CI：0.11-0.90）。在无AF患者中，iPOSA与较低的EDS比值相关（aOR：0.28，95%CI：0.10-0.75）。

结论：POSA与EDS之间的关联因POSA定义和AF状态而异。研究结果提示，在AF患者中，EDS的表现因cPOSA状态而异。

title: Substrate-Dependent Pro- and Antiarrhythmic Action of Omecamtiv Mecarbil at the Ventricular and Atrial Level: Insights from a Langendorff-Perfused Rabbit Heart Model.
summary: Omecamtiv mecarbil is a cardiac-selective myosin activator and potential heart failure treatment, but its electrophysiological profile remains incompletely characterized. We investigated omecamtiv mecarbil in a Langendorff-perfused rabbit heart model. Forty-eight rabbit hearts were retrogradely perfused; twenty-four in a ventricular and twenty-four in an atrial setup. In the ventricular setup, action potential duration at 90% repolarization (APD90), QT interval, and dispersion of repolarization were assessed during pacing at seven cycle lengths. After baseline recordings, Group 1 (n = 12) received 1, 5 and 10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil sequentially, while Group 2 (n = 12) received 100 µM sotalol followed by 5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil. In the atrial setup, Group 3 (n = 12) received 5 and 10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil, and Group 4 (n = 12) received isoproterenol/acetylcholine (IsoACh) to increase atrial fibrillation (AF) susceptibility, followed by 5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil. Omecamtiv mecarbil alone shortened ventricular APD90 and QT interval, increased dispersion of repolarization, and raised ventricular arrhythmia incidence. Sotalol prolonged APD90, QT interval, and dispersion, with a marked rise in VT episodes; additional omecamtiv mecarbil did not further prolong repolarization but increased arrhythmia susceptibility further. In the atrial setup, omecamtiv mecarbil alone prolonged conduction time and increased AF inducibility. Under IsoACh, which shortened atrial APD and refractoriness and increased AF episodes, additional omecamtiv mecarbil slowed atrial conduction and markedly suppressed AF. In summary, omecamtiv mecarbil was proarrhythmic at the ventricular level, particularly under reduced repolarization reserve, but showed antiarrhythmic effects in an IsoACh-induced AF model and proarrhythmic properties in the healthy atrium, indicating a substrate-dependent electrophysiological profile.

AI.tldr: 在Langendorff灌流兔心模型中，心肌肌球蛋白激活剂omecamtiv mecarbil表现出底物依赖的电生理作用：在心室水平缩短复极、增加复极离散度和室性心律失常，在IsoACh诱导的房颤模型中反而显著抑制房颤。
AI.motivation: Omecamtiv mecarbil是心脏选择性肌球蛋白激活剂，被视为心力衰竭的潜在治疗药物，但其电生理特征尚未被充分阐明。既往研究对其在心室与心房水平是否存在致心律失常或抗心律失常作用缺乏系统评价，而这一信息对合并心律失常风险的心衰患者用药安全至关重要。
AI.method: 研究为离体动物实验。48只兔心经Langendorff逆行灌流，其中心室标本24只、心房标本24只。心室组在7个起搏周长下测定动作电位复极90%时程（APD90）、QT间期及复极离散度；Group 1（n=12）依次给予1、5、10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，Group 2（n=12）先给100 µM索他洛尔再给5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。心房组中Group 3（n=12）接受5与10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，Group 4（n=12）先以异丙肾上腺素/乙酰胆碱（IsoACh）提高房颤易感性，再加用5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。终点为APD90、QT间期、复极离散度、传导时间、房颤诱发率与室性心律失常发生率；具体统计方法与P值摘要未报告。
AI.result: 单用omecamtiv mecarbil缩短心室APD90与QT间期、增大复极离散度并提高室性心律失常发生率。索他洛尔延长APD90、QT间期及复极离散度，室性心动过速（VT）发作显著增多；在此基础上追加omecamtiv mecarbil未进一步延长复极，但心律失常易感性进一步升高。心房水平，单用omecamtiv mecarbil延长传导时间并提高房颤诱发率；在IsoACh（缩短心房APD与不应期、增加房颤发作）背景下，追加omecamtiv mecarbil减慢心房传导并显著抑制房颤。效应量与95%置信区间摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该离体兔心研究提示omecamtiv mecarbil的电生理效应具有底物依赖性：在复极储备正常或降低的心室中表现为促心律失常，在健康心房中亦促房颤，但在IsoACh诱导的房颤模型中呈抗心律失常作用。临床意义在于心衰患者使用该药时需关注心室复极与室性心律失常风险，尤其合并使用延长QT药物（如索他洛尔）时；其房颤抑制作用则提示潜在的治疗价值。局限性为离体动物模型、样本量小、药物浓度高于临床血药浓度、缺乏效应量与统计细节，结论需在体实验与临床研究验证。

summary_zh: Omecamtiv mecarbil 是一种心脏选择性肌球蛋白激活剂，也是潜在的心力衰竭治疗药物，但其电生理特征仍未被完全阐明。我们在 Langendorff 灌流兔心模型中研究了 omecamtiv mecarbil。对48只兔心进行逆行灌流；其中24只采用心室标本，24只采用心房标本。在心室标本中，于七个周期长度起搏期间评估90%复极时动作电位时程（APD90）、QT间期和复极离散度。基线记录后，第1组（n = 12）依次接受1、5和10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，而第2组（n = 12）先接受100 µM 索他洛尔，随后接受5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。在心房标本中，第3组（n = 12）接受5和10 µM omecamtiv mecarbil，第4组（n = 12）接受异丙肾上腺素/乙酰胆碱（IsoACh）以增加心房颤动（AF）易感性，随后接受5 µM omecamtiv mecarbil。单用 omecamtiv mecarbil 缩短心室 APD90 和 QT 间期，增加复极离散度，并提高室性心律失常发生率。索他洛尔延长 APD90、QT 间期和复极离散度，并显著增加室性心动过速（VT）发作；加用 omecamtiv mecarbil 未进一步延长复极，但进一步增加心律失常易感性。在心房标本中，单用 omecamtiv mecarbil 延长传导时间并增加 AF 的可诱发性。在 IsoACh 作用下（其缩短心房 APD 和不应期，并增加 AF 发作），加用 omecamtiv mecarbil 减慢心房传导并显著抑制 AF。总之，omecamtiv mecarbil 在心室水平具有致心律失常作用，尤其是在复极储备降低时；但在 IsoACh 诱导的 AF 模型中表现出抗心律失常作用，而在健康心房中具有致心律失常特性，表明其电生理特征具有基质依赖性。

title: Gut microbiota-activated PLCγ2 monocytes drive atrial fibrillation.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained arrhythmia, conferring risks of stroke and heart failure. Monocyte activation-associated inflammation is implicated in AF, yet the recruitment of monocytes and their role in atrial remodeling remain unclear. Here we show that monocytes from AF patients upregulate phospholipase C gamma 2 (PLCG2). In a combined AF male mouse model, phospho-PLCγ2+ monocytes are recruited to the atria, where they trigger endothelial‑to‑mesenchymal transition (EndMT) through the secreted phosphoprotein 1 (SPP1)-integrin α9β1 signaling axis. Monocyte-specific deletion of PLCG2 blocks atrial recruitment of these monocytes and reduces AF. Depletion of the gut microbiota with antibiotics reduces the number of phospho-PLCγ2+ monocytes in the atria, suppresses EndMT, and attenuates AF inducibility, and these effects are reversed by fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT). Mechanistically, gut microbiota-derived bacterial membrane vesicles activate spleen tyrosine kinase (Syk)/PLCG2 signaling in monocytes. These findings establish a gut microbiota-monocyte-EndMT axis, wherein monocyte-endocardial crosstalk drives AF.

AI.tldr: 在房颤患者与雄性小鼠中，肠道菌群膜囊泡激活单核细胞Syk/PLCG2，促其心房募集并经SPP1-整合素α9β1诱导内皮间质转化，驱动房颤。
AI.motivation: AF是最常见的持续性心律失常，显著增加卒中与心衰风险；单核细胞活化相关炎症被认为参与AF，但单核细胞如何被募集及其在心房重构中的作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 转化实验研究：分析AF患者单核细胞；采用联合AF雄性小鼠模型，行单核细胞特异性PLCG2敲除、抗生素清除肠道菌群、粪菌移植（FMT）及细菌膜囊泡干预；评估单核细胞PLCG2表达、心房磷酸化PLCγ2+单核细胞募集、内皮间质转化（EndMT）与AF可诱发性。样本量及具体统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: AF患者单核细胞PLCG2上调；AF雄性小鼠心房募集磷酸化PLCγ2+单核细胞，经SPP1-整合素α9β1轴触发EndMT。单核细胞PLCG2缺失阻断心房募集并减少AF；抗生素清除菌群降低心房磷酸化PLCγ2+单核细胞、抑制EndMT并降低AF可诱发性，FMT可逆转上述效应；菌群来源细菌膜囊泡激活单核细胞Syk/PLCG2信号。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出“肠道菌群-单核细胞-EndMT”轴，单核细胞与心内膜细胞串话驱动AF，为AF抗炎及菌群相关干预提供新靶点；但证据主要来自雄性小鼠和转化实验，人体因果性、临床终点及安全性未证实，尚不能改变现行电生理实践。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是最常见的持续性心律失常，会带来卒中和心力衰竭风险。单核细胞活化相关炎症与AF有关，但单核细胞的募集及其在心房重构中的作用仍不清楚。本研究表明，AF患者的单核细胞上调磷脂酶Cγ2（PLCG2）。在复合AF雄性小鼠模型中，磷酸化PLCγ2+单核细胞被募集至心房，并通过分泌型磷蛋白1（SPP1）-整合素α9β1信号轴触发内皮-间充质转化（EndMT）。单核细胞特异性敲除PLCG2可阻断这些单核细胞向心房的募集并减少AF。使用抗生素清除肠道菌群可减少心房中磷酸化PLCγ2+单核细胞的数量、抑制EndMT并减弱AF可诱发性，而这些效应可被粪菌移植（FMT）逆转。机制上，肠道菌群来源的细菌膜囊泡激活单核细胞中的脾酪氨酸激酶（Syk）/PLCG2信号。这些发现确立了一条肠道菌群-单核细胞-EndMT轴，其中单核细胞与心内膜的交互作用驱动AF。

title: Quantitative imaging analysis in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: phenotypic differentiation to prognostic stratification.
summary: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is the most common inherited cardiac disorder and remains associated with sudden cardiac death (SCD), heart failure, and diagnostic uncertainty due to overlap with other causes of left ventricular hypertrophy, including hypertensive heart disease and cardiac amyloidosis. This review aimed to evaluate the evolving applications of radiomics in the context of related quantitative imaging techniques. A review was conducted of studies applying radiomics, texture analysis, machine learning, and deep learning to cardiac imaging in HCM. The evidence base derives predominantly from CMR, with a smaller and more recent body of work in echocardiography and CT. Current evidence suggests that radiomics can extract quantitative features of myocardial texture, shape, and signal heterogeneity beyond visual assessment. These approaches have shown promise in differentiating HCM from phenocopies, identifying myocardial fibrosis without contrast administration, and improving the prediction of adverse outcomes, including SCD and heart failure. Several studies reported incremental value over conventional imaging markers such as wall thickness, global T1 values, and binary late gadolinium enhancement. However, the literature remains limited by retrospective study design, small cohorts, heterogeneity in imaging acquisition and segmentation, and insufficient external validation. Radiomics has emerged as a promising adjunct to conventional cardiac imaging in HCM, with the potential to be adapted into a clinical decision support tool. Its future clinical role will depend on methodological standardization and robust external validation.

title: Delayed cardiac conduction disease in a young adult following childhood Chagas infection.
summary:
PRESENTATION: A Bolivian man in his 30s presented to the ED with non-exertional chest pain and intermittent second-degree atrioventricular (2:1) block.

DIAGNOSIS: Given a history of untreated childhood Trypanosoma cruzi infection and family history of Chagas heart disease, late cardiac manifestation was suspected. Structural and ischaemic causes were excluded.

TREATMENT: Antiparasitic therapy was initiated. Pacemaker implantation was considered but deferred following shared decision-making due to absence of symptoms.

DISCUSSION: Chagas heart disease (CHD) may present decades after infection with conduction abnormalities. Recognition in the ED is essential to enable appropriate management and reduce the risk of progression to complete heart block and sudden cardiac death.

title: Clinical readiness and methodological rigor of AI models for ventricular arrhythmia and sudden cardiac death prediction: A systematic review with PROBAST+AI appraisal.
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) remains a major cause of mortality, and risk stratification based on left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) has significant limitations. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a potential approach for modeling complex arrhythmic risk. We conducted a systematic review with prespecified anchor subgroup reporting (without pooling) to evaluate the performance of AI models in predicting SCD and malignant ventricular arrhythmias. We searched MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase, and Scopus from inception to 3 October 2025. Anchor subgroup reporting was restricted to studies reporting area under the receiver-operating characteristic curve (AUROC) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) within predefined modality/horizon subgroups. Studies without CIs or relying on cross-validation variance were summarized narratively as supplementary evidence. Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria; five reported AUROC with 95% CIs within prespecified modality/horizon subgroups and were included as anchor subgroup estimates (k=1 per subgroup). Methodological quality and reporting were limited: 54% of studies (7/13) were classified as high risk of bias according to PROBAST+AI, driven by cross-validation-only designs, unit-of-analysis issues, limited external validation, and sparse calibration reporting. Among anchor estimates, deep learning on single-lead ambulatory ECG showed high discrimination for near-term ventricular tachyarrhythmias (AUROC 0.948, 95% CI 0.926-0.967), while 12-lead ECG models achieved good performance for long-term SCD (AUROC 0.820, 95% CI 0.794-0.847). The multimodal anchor estimate (AUROC 0.84) was numerically higher than the CMR radiomics anchor (AUROC 0.70), but this represents an indirect between-study contrast. AI-ECG models show high reported discrimination in near-term risk windows, but cross-study comparisons are indirect, and methodological heterogeneity remains a barrier to translation into clinical practice.

AI.motivation: 心脏性猝死仍是主要死亡原因之一，而仅凭LVEF进行风险分层存在明显局限，亟需更精准的建模手段。人工智能被认为能够刻画复杂的致心律失常风险，但既往缺乏对其模型性能与方法学质量的系统评估，尤其是外部验证、校准报告和偏倚风险方面的证据缺口。

AI.result: 13项研究中仅5项在预设模态/时间窗亚组内报告了带95%CI的AUROC，构成锚定估计，每个亚组k=1。7/13（54%）被PROBAST+AI判定为高偏倚风险，主要源于仅采用交叉验证的设计、分析单位问题、外部验证不足及校准报告稀少。锚定估计中，单导联动态心电图深度学习模型对近期室性快速性心律失常判别力高（AUROC 0.948，95%CI 0.926–0.967）；12导联心电图模型对长期SCD预测性能良好（AUROC 0.820，95%CI 0.794–0.847）。多模态锚定估计AUROC 0.84，数值上高于心脏磁共振放射组学锚定估计的0.70，但属研究间间接比较。
AI.conclusion: AI-ECG模型在近期风险时间窗内报告了较高的判别性能，但各锚定亚组仅含单一研究、缺乏合并估计，研究间比较均为间接对比，加之方法学异质性与高偏倚风险普遍存在，目前尚不足以支持其进入临床风险分层流程。未来研究需加强外部验证、规范的校准报告与前瞻性队列验证，方可评估其相对于LVEF分层的增量价值。

title: The Regionalization of High-Volume Cardiac Pacing: A Prospective Cohort Study on Safety, Feasibility, and the Learning Curve in a Geriatric Population.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Centralizing pacemaker implantations delays care for geriatric populations in remote regions, particularly in post-Soviet healthcare systems like Latvia. We hypothesized that a regional hospital could safely establish a high-volume pacing program to overcome geographical barriers, utilizing structured mentorship from a national tertiary center.

METHODS: This 2-year prospective observational study evaluated 173 consecutive patients (mean age 78.1 years) undergoing permanent pacemaker implantation at Daugavpils Regional Hospital. Procedures were performed by two regional interventional cardiologists transitioning to independent practice, supported by Latvian Cardiology Centre mentors. Endpoints included 30-day major complications, procedural efficiency, surgical learning curve evaluation using Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) analysis, and patient-reported quality of life (AQUAREL, SF-36).

RESULTS: Across 173 procedures (66.5% dual-chamber, 33.5% single-chamber), the overall complication rate was 5.7%. CUSUM analysis demonstrated a complication rate reduction from 8.7% during the initial acquisition phase to a 3.4% expertise plateau. Procedural efficiency stabilized with a mean fluoroscopy time of 3.9 min. Specific complications included lead dislodgement (2.3%), pocket hematoma (1.7%), pneumothorax (1.1%), and wound infection (0.6%), managed successfully without mortality or device abandonment. At 6-month follow-up, patients reported significant quality of life improvements and high trust in the regional team.

CONCLUSIONS: Regional high-volume cardiac pacing programs are safe and vital for equitable geriatric care. With structured mentorship, regional hospitals can overcome historical centralization, safely transitioning to independent high-volume centers and achieving an expert-level safety profile non-inferior to tertiary standards.

title: Subcutaneous and Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Clinical Framework for Breast Surgery, Pregnancy, Lactation, Radiation Therapy, and Breast Imaging.
summary: The subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator and extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator do not require intravascular, intracardiac, or epicardial leads, making them attractive alternatives to transvenous implantable cardioverter defibrillators in patients without bradycardia pacing or cardiac resynchronization therapy indications. These systems are especially useful for patients with venous access challenges and those at risk for endovascular infections, including patients with renal failure or those who are immunocompromised. Women with prior or anticipated breast surgery, such as mastectomy or breast reconstruction surgery, or those who are lactating present unique anatomic, procedural, and post-operative quality-of-life considerations. This commentary provides a practical, scenario-based framework for managing this unique patient group. Key considerations include individualized incision and pulse generator planning, proactive multidisciplinary coordination, procedure-specific management, and shared decision-making in patients with prior or anticipated breast augmentation or reduction, pregnancy, lactation, mastectomy, radiation therapy, and breast imaging.

AI.tldr: 该评论针对既往或计划接受乳房手术、妊娠、哺乳、放疗及乳腺影像检查的女性患者，提出皮下ICD与血管外ICD的个体化围术期与随访管理框架。

AI.method: 本文为评论性文章（commentary），非原创临床研究；摘要未报告研究对象、样本量、终点定义及统计方法。文章按临床情景构建实用框架，覆盖既往或计划行乳房增大或缩小术、乳房切除与重建、妊娠、哺乳、放疗及乳腺影像检查的患者；核心内容包括个体化切口与脉冲发生器埋置规划、前瞻性多学科协调、术式特异性管理以及共享决策。

title: Leadless pacemaker in atrioventricular block patients with specific indications: a systematic review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Leadless cardiac pacemakers are becoming a viable alternative to traditional intravenous pacemakers. This study aims to systematically evaluate the safety of using leadless pacemakers in patients with atrioventricular block (AVB) who meet specific indications, based on existing published research.

METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, Embase, Cochrane Library, ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP) and Wanfang Database for clinical studies on leadless pacemaker treatment for atrioventricular block. Data analysis was conducted using RevMan and R software. Relative risk (RR) with 95% confidence interval (CI) was calculated. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I2 statistic.

RESULTS: A total of 60 studies were ultimately included, with AVB patients accounting for 6% to 100% of the implanted population. The overall incidence of adverse events in patients receiving leadless pacemakers was low. Among these, 16 studies provided complication data for the AVB subgroup and were included in the meta-analysis. The results showed that, compared with the control group, leadless pacemakers did not significantly reduce the risk of adverse events in AVB patients (RR = 1.41, 95% CI: 0.43-4.60, P = 0.57). Subgroup analysis by device type demonstrated no statistically significant differences in adverse event risks compared to traditional pacemakers for either single-chamber ventricular leadless pacemakers (RR = 0.26, 95% CI: 0.03-2.01, P = 0.20) or AV-synchronous/dual-chamber leadless pacemakers (RR = 2.16, 95% CI: 0.76-6.17, P = 0.15), with no significant interaction between subgroups. In the single-arm rate analysis, five cohort studies reported an adverse event rate of 14% (95% CI: 0.04-0.24); after applying the Freeman-Tukey transformation to eleven single-arm studies, the adverse event rate was 1.15% (95% CI: 0.26%-2.67%).

CONCLUSION: In patients with atrioventricular block, leadless pacemakers demonstrate no significant difference in the risk of adverse events compared with conventional pacemakers, with lower complication rates and favorable clinical feasibility.

AI.tldr: 系统评价纳入60项研究显示，在房室传导阻滞患者中，无导线起搏器的不良事件风险与传统起搏器无显著差异（RR=1.41，95%CI 0.43-4.60），单臂汇总并发症率约1.15%。
AI.motivation: 无导线起搏器正逐渐成为传统经静脉起搏器的替代方案，但针对房室传导阻滞（AVB）这一特定适应症人群的安全性证据仍较分散，既往多为单臂研究，缺乏与传统起搏器的系统比较；同时，不同器械类型（单腔心室型与房室同步型或双腔型）在AVB人群中的风险差异尚不明确。
AI.method: 系统评价与meta分析。检索PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI、Embase、Cochrane Library、ClinicalTrials.gov、WHO ICTRP及万方数据库中关于无导线起搏器治疗AVB的临床研究；采用RevMan与R软件分析，效应量为相对危险度（RR）及95%CI，以I2统计量评估异质性，并对单臂研究行率合并（含Freeman-Tukey转换）。最终纳入60项研究，其中16项提供AVB亚组并发症数据并进入meta分析；AVB患者在植入人群中所占比例为6%~100%。
AI.result: AVB患者植入无导线起搏器后总体不良事件发生率低。meta分析显示，与对照组相比，无导线起搏器未显著降低AVB患者的不良事件风险（RR=1.41，95%CI 0.43-4.60，P=0.57）。按器械类型行亚组分析：单腔心室无导线起搏器RR=0.26（95%CI 0.03-2.01，P=0.20），房室同步型或双腔无导线起搏器RR=2.16（95%CI 0.76-6.17，P=0.15），两亚组间无显著交互作用。单臂率分析中，5项队列研究报告不良事件率为14%（95%CI 0.04-0.24）；11项单臂研究经Freeman-Tukey转换后不良事件率为1.15%（95%CI 0.26%-2.67%）。异质性I2具体数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在AVB患者中，无导线起搏器与传统起搏器的不良事件风险无显著差异，并发症率较低、临床可行性良好。但合并效应量置信区间较宽、随机对照证据有限，且单臂率分析结果（14%与1.15%）相差悬殊，提示结论需谨慎解读。对电生理实践而言，无导线起搏器可作为AVB患者（尤其存在静脉通路受限者）的可行选择，但房室同步型或双腔器械的安全性证据仍不充分，尚需大样本随机对照研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：无导线心脏起搏器正逐渐成为传统经静脉起搏器的一种可行替代方案。本研究旨在基于现有的已发表研究，系统评价在符合特定适应证的房室传导阻滞（AVB）患者中使用无导线起搏器的安全性。

方法：全面检索 PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI、Embase、Cochrane Library、ClinicalTrials.gov、WHO 国际临床试验注册平台（ICTRP）及万方数据库中关于无导线起搏器治疗房室传导阻滞的临床研究。采用 RevMan 与 R 软件进行数据分析，计算相对危险度（RR）及其 95% 置信区间（CI），并采用 I2 统计量评估异质性。

结论：在房室传导阻滞患者中，无导线起搏器与传统起搏器相比不良事件风险无显著差异，且并发症发生率较低，临床可行性良好。

title: 5G Cloud-Enabled Telemedicine for Remote Management of Heart Failure Patients With Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Multicenter Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: Postoperative follow-up for patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators and cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillators (ICD/CRT-D) is often delayed in remote areas because of geographic barriers and limited healthcare resources, increasing the risk of adverse outcomes. The "Make Changes" study, was a prospective, multicenter, open-label randomized trial evaluating a 5G-cloud technology platform (5G-CTP) for real-time remote device interrogation and reprogramming versus standard In-clinic care. Between October 2022 and February 2024, 206 patients from five centers were randomly assigned to 12 months of follow-up with 5G-CTP (n = 104) or In-clinic care (n = 102). For the primary endpoint of time from clinical event to intervention, the 5G-CTP group had a significantly shorter response time than the In-Clinic group (4.2 vs. 11.5 days; p < 0.001). For secondary endpoints, the 5G-CTP group showed greater improvement in life quality at 12 months based on Minnesota Living with Heart Failure Questionnaire (p = 0.012). Rates of unplanned visits and clinical interventions were similar between groups, with no procedure-related complications. This model integrates community hospitals with implantation centers through 5G networks, enabling timely specialist-directed care locally without long-distance travel. It is a feasible strategy for postoperative ICD/CRT-D management, particularly in underserved regions with limited access to specialized cardiac care.

AI.tldr: 多中心随机对照试验显示，基于5G云的远程设备程控（5G-CTP）使ICD/CRT-D患者从临床事件到干预的时间由11.5天缩短至4.2天，并改善12个月生活质量。
AI.motivation: ICD/CRT-D术后随访依赖门诊程控，偏远地区因地理阻隔和医疗资源不足常导致随访延迟，不良结局风险升高。既往远程监测多限于数据传输与报警，缺乏实时设备程控与再编程能力，5G低延迟网络能否支撑“就地完成专科指令化干预”尚缺随机证据。
AI.method: 前瞻性、多中心、开放标签随机对照试验（“Make Changes”研究），2022年10月至2024年2月在5家中心纳入206例ICD/CRT-D患者，随机分为5G-CTP远程随访组（n=104）与常规门诊随访组（n=102），随访12个月。主要终点为临床事件发生至实施干预的时间；次要终点包括12个月明尼苏达心力衰竭生活质量问卷（MLHFQ）改善、非计划就诊与临床干预发生率及手术相关并发症。摘要未报告具体统计方法及效应量的95%CI。
AI.result: 主要终点方面，5G-CTP组事件至干预时间显著短于门诊组（4.2天 vs 11.5天，p<0.001）。12个月MLHFQ生活质量改善在5G-CTP组更明显（p=0.012）。两组非计划就诊率与临床干预率相近，未发生操作相关并发症。摘要未报告两组具体生活质量评分差值、95%CI及事件例数。
AI.conclusion: 由5G网络连接社区医院与植入中心、实现实时远程设备 interrog 与再编程的模式可行，可在患者本地提供及时的专科指令化处理，避免长途转运，适用于专科资源匮乏地区。局限性包括开放标签设计、样本量较小、随访仅12个月、单国多中心，且摘要未报告硬终点（如恰当放电、心衰住院）差异，需更长期数据验证其对临床结局的影响。

summary_zh: 对于植入式心律转复除颤器和心脏再同步治疗除颤器（ICD/CRT-D）患者，术后随访在偏远地区常因地理障碍和医疗资源有限而延迟，从而增加不良结局风险。“Make Changes”研究是一项前瞻性、多中心、开放标签随机试验，评估5G云技术平台（5G-CTP）用于实时远程设备询问和再程控，并与标准门诊随访进行比较。2022年10月至2024年2月，来自5个中心的206例患者被随机分配接受5G-CTP随访（n = 104）或门诊随访（n = 102），随访12个月。对于主要终点，即从临床事件到干预的时间，5G-CTP组的响应时间显著短于门诊随访组（4.2 vs. 11.5天；p < 0.001）。对于次要终点，基于明尼苏达心力衰竭生活质量问卷，5G-CTP组在12个月时的生活质量改善更明显（p = 0.012）。两组非计划就诊率和临床干预率相似，且无操作相关并发症。该模式通过5G网络将社区医院与植入中心整合，使患者无需长途出行即可在当地及时获得专科医生指导的诊疗。对于ICD/CRT-D术后管理，这是一种可行的策略，尤其在获得专科心脏诊疗服务有限的欠发达地区。

title: A compartmentalized SCN model explains temperature resistance through interregional phase differences.
summary: Temperature cycles entrain circadian rhythms in many peripheral tissues, yet the master circadian pacemaker (suprachiasmatic nucleus) in mammals remains largely insensitive to the same input. Despite their similar molecular circuitry, the mechanisms underlying the distinct temperature responses of central and peripheral clocks remain unclear. To address this, we developed a compartmentalized model of the SCN circadian clock that integrates the heat shock protein (HSP) pathway, simulating the response of the SCN network to temperature variations. Using this model, we successfully recapitulated key experimental observations, including the ability of heat stimuli to entrain peripheral clocks to an inverted phase while the SCN maintains its resistance. Further analysis reveals that intrinsic phase heterogeneity among SCN subregions underlies this entrainment resistance. Specifically, the phase difference between the dorsal and ventral SCN leads to divergent phase responses upon simultaneous stimulation, resulting in an attenuated net shift of the overall SCN phase. Moreover, the mode of thermal input, in which the dorsal and ventral regions are stimulated concurrently, may further enhance the SCN's robustness to temperature entrainment. These results suggest that the SCN's resistance to temperature entrainment may differ mechanistically from photic entrainment, and highlight the potential importance of its spatial structure in maintaining circadian stability.

AI.tldr: 通过整合热休克蛋白通路的区室化视交叉上核（SCN）计算模型，发现背侧与腹侧 SCN 之间的内在相位异质性可解释 SCN 对温度授时的抵抗，而外周钟仍可被热刺激倒相。
AI.motivation: 温度周期能同步化多种外周组织的昼夜节律，但哺乳动物主起搏器 SCN 对同样的温度输入基本不敏感。尽管中枢与外周钟的分子环路相似，二者温度反应差异的机制一直不清楚；既往实验观察到热刺激可使外周钟相位倒转而 SCN 保持抵抗，但缺乏能统一解释该现象的网络层面机制模型。
AI.method: 研究为计算生物学建模研究，非临床人群研究，无样本量与干预分组（摘要未报告）。作者构建了整合热休克蛋白（HSP）通路的区室化 SCN 昼夜节律模型，用以模拟 SCN 网络对不同温度变化的响应；并以已知实验现象（热刺激使外周钟倒相、SCN 维持抵抗）作为模型复现与验证的靶点，进而分析 SCN 各亚区相位关系对整体相位移动的影响。主要观察指标为模型中外周钟与 SCN 整体相位的移动方向与幅度，以及背、腹侧亚区的相位差；统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 模型成功复现了关键实验观察：热刺激可将外周钟同步至倒转相位，而 SCN 保持对温度授时的抵抗。进一步模拟显示，SCN 亚区间的内在相位异质性是这种抵抗的基础——背侧与腹侧 SCN 之间的相位差使二者在同时受刺激时产生方向不一致的相位反应，从而使 SCN 整体净相位移动被削弱；此外，背、腹侧同时接受热输入的模式可能进一步增强 SCN 对温度授时的稳健性。摘要未报告具体效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提示 SCN 对温度授时的抵抗与光授时在机制上并不相同，其空间结构（尤其是背-腹侧相位差）在维持昼夜节律稳定性中可能具有重要作用。需注意本研究为纯计算模拟，结论依赖模型假设与参数设定，尚缺乏在体验证，摘要亦未提供定量指标；该工作属于昼夜节律基础研究，与心脏电生理器械治疗无直接关联，对电生理临床实践暂无直接指导意义。

summary_zh: 温度周期能够同步许多外周组织中的昼夜节律，但哺乳动物的主昼夜节律起搏器（视交叉上核，SCN）对同一输入仍基本不敏感。尽管中枢时钟与外周时钟的分子环路相似，但二者温度反应差异背后的机制仍不清楚。为此，我们建立了一个整合热休克蛋白（HSP）通路的 SCN 昼夜节律时钟分区化模型，以模拟 SCN 网络对温度变化的反应。利用该模型，我们成功重现了关键的实验观察结果，包括热刺激能够将外周时钟同步至倒转相位，而 SCN 仍保持其抵抗性。进一步分析显示，SCN 各亚区之间固有的相位异质性是这种同步抵抗性的基础。具体而言，SCN 背侧与腹侧之间的相位差导致同时刺激时出现不同的相位反应，从而使 SCN 整体相位的净位移减弱。此外，背侧与腹侧区域同时受到刺激这种热输入方式，可能进一步增强 SCN 对温度同步的稳健性。这些结果提示，SCN 对温度同步的抵抗在机制上可能不同于光同步，并凸显了其空间结构在维持昼夜节律稳定性中的潜在重要性。

title: Lead-to-Vein Ratio and Long-Term Vascular Safety After Transvenous Pacing in Children Weighing ≤15 Kg.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Transvenous pacing in low-weight children is technically feasible, but its clinical use depends on long-term venous patency, system performance, and ventricular function. We aimed to describe imaging-defined venous abnormalities and clinically overt vascular events after first transvenous pacemaker implantation and to explore whether the lead-to-vein ratio provides anatomical information beyond body weight.

METHODS: This prospective observational cohort included 35 children weighing ≤15 kg undergoing first transvenous pacemaker implantation between 2010 and 2020. The primary vascular endpoint was imaging-defined venous thrombosis, occlusion, or stenosis ≥50%; clinical impact was recorded separately. Device-related safety, minimum venous diameter, lead-to-vein ratio, ventricular function, synchrony, and paced QRS duration were analyzed using non-parametric, exact, and exploratory univariable tests.

RESULTS: Median follow-up was 6.7 [4.5-8.2] years. Eleven patients weighed <10 kg and 3 weighed <5 kg. The imaging-defined vascular endpoint occurred in 6/35 patients; 5 were asymptomatic surveillance findings and 1 was clinically symptomatic. The lead-to-vein ratio was higher in patients with the endpoint than in those without events (0.59 [0.55-0.63] vs. 0.47 [0.43-0.51]; p = 0.003). A ratio >0.55 was associated with more frequent imaging-defined endpoints (4/8 vs. 2/27; odds ratio 12.5; 95% confidence interval 1.7-92.3). Left ventricular ejection fraction remained preserved.

CONCLUSION: During the first transvenous system lifespan, imaging-defined venous abnormalities were relatively frequent but mostly asymptomatic, whereas clinically overt vascular complications were uncommon. The lead-to-vein ratio may support anatomical pre-implant risk stratification, although multicenter validation and follow-up beyond generator replacement are required.

AI.tldr: 在≤15 kg儿童首次经静脉起搏器植入后中位6.7年随访中，影像学静脉异常较常见但多为无症状，临床显性血管并发症少见；导线/静脉比值>0.55与影像学终点风险升高相关。
AI.motivation: 低体重儿童经静脉起搏技术可行，但长期静脉通畅性、系统性能和心室功能决定其临床价值；既往对影像学静脉异常与临床显性血管事件的关系，以及导线/静脉比值能否在体重之外提供解剖风险信息尚不明确。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性队列，纳入2010—2020年首次接受经静脉起搏器植入、体重≤15 kg的儿童35例。主要血管终点为影像学定义的静脉血栓、闭塞或狭窄≥50%，临床影响单独记录；同时分析器械相关安全性、最小静脉直径、导线/静脉比值、心室功能、同步性及起搏QRS时限，采用非参数、精确检验及探索性单变量分析。
AI.result: 中位随访6.7（4.5—8.2）年；11例体重<10 kg，3例<5 kg。6/35例达到影像学血管终点，其中5例为无症状监测发现、1例有临床症状。发生终点者导线/静脉比值高于无事件者（0.59 [0.55—0.63] vs. 0.47 [0.43—0.51]，P=0.003）；比值>0.55与影像学终点更常见相关（4/8 vs. 2/27；OR 12.5，95%CI 1.7—92.3）。LVEF保持正常。器械相关安全性、同步性及起搏QRS时限的具体数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在首个经静脉起搏系统使用寿命内，影像学静脉异常相对常见但多无症状，临床显性血管并发症少见；导线/静脉比值可能有助于植入前解剖风险分层。但样本量小、分析为探索性，需多中心验证及超过起搏器更换周期的随访。

summary_zh:
背景：低体重儿童经静脉起搏在技术上是可行的，但其临床应用取决于长期静脉通畅性、系统性能和心室功能。我们旨在描述首次经静脉起搏器植入后影像学定义的静脉异常和临床明显的血管事件，并探讨导线-静脉比值是否提供超越体重的解剖学信息。

方法：本前瞻性观察性队列纳入2010年至2020年间接受首次经静脉起搏器植入的35例体重≤15 kg的儿童。主要血管终点为影像学定义的静脉血栓形成、闭塞或狭窄≥50%；临床影响单独记录。器械相关安全性、最小静脉直径、导线-静脉比值、心室功能、同步性及起搏QRS时限采用非参数检验、精确检验和探索性单变量检验进行分析。

结果：中位随访时间为6.7 [4.5-8.2]年。11例患者体重<10 kg，3例体重<5 kg。影像学定义的血管终点发生于6/35例患者；其中5例为无症状监测发现，1例有临床症状。发生终点的患者导线-静脉比值高于无事件患者（0.59 [0.55-0.63] 对 0.47 [0.43-0.51]；p = 0.003）。比值>0.55与更频繁的影像学定义终点相关（4/8 对 2/27；比值比 12.5；95%置信区间 1.7-92.3）。左心室射血分数仍保持正常。

结论：在首个经静脉系统使用寿命期间，影像学定义的静脉异常相对常见，但大多无症状，而临床明显的血管并发症不常见。导线-静脉比值可能有助于植入前解剖学风险分层，但仍需多中心验证以及超过脉冲发生器更换后的随访。

title: Biventricular Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy: Diagnostic Insights from Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance.
summary: • ACM is an uncommon but important cause of chest pain. • ACM should be suspected in individuals presenting with VAs. • Echocardiography should be the initial screening tool for ACM. • Three-dimensional TTE or CMR may be considered if clinical suspicion of ACM persists. • CMR plays a crucial role in diagnosing and risk-stratifying ACM.

AI.tldr: 双心室致心律失常性心肌病虽少见，但在室性心律失常患者中应警惕；超声为首筛，CMR对诊断与危险分层关键。
AI.motivation: ACM 是不常见但重要的胸痛病因，临床易漏诊；对于以室性心律失常（VAs）就诊者应提高怀疑。既往证据缺口在于如何通过影像学检查流程早期识别并完成危险分层，摘要强调需明确超声、三维经胸超声心动图（3D TTE）与心血管磁共振（CMR）的定位。
AI.method: 本文摘要以要点形式总结双心室 ACM 的影像诊断思路，未报告研究类型、研究对象、样本量、干预或暴露、主要/次要终点定义及统计方法；因此无法提取效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果。诊断路径要点为：超声心动图应作为 ACM 的初始筛查工具；若临床仍怀疑 ACM，可考虑三维 TTE 或 CMR；CMR 在 ACM 的诊断和危险分层中起关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 对临床实践而言，室性心律失常患者应警惕 ACM，超声首筛后按怀疑程度进阶至三维 TTE 或 CMR，CMR 对诊断与危险分层具有核心价值。局限性是摘要未提供原始研究数据、样本量及统计结果，无法评估诊断准确性或预后效应。

summary_zh:
• 致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）是胸痛的一种不常见但重要的病因。

• 对于表现为室性心律失常（VAs）的个体，应怀疑 ACM。

• 超声心动图应作为 ACM 的初始筛查工具。

• 如果临床仍怀疑 ACM，可考虑三维经胸超声心动图（TTE）或心脏磁共振（CMR）。

• CMR 在 ACM 的诊断和风险分层中起着关键作用。

title: Affordable and Efficient Anatomy Mapping for LBBAP in Dextrocardia With Complete Heart Block
summary: We reported the case of a 77-year-old woman with dextrocardia and complete heart block, demonstrating the effectiveness of simplified anatomical mapping imaging and modified catheter techniques to achieve selective left bundle branch pacing (LBBP).

AI.tldr: 在1例77岁右位心合并完全性心脏传导阻滞患者中，简化解剖标测影像联合改良导管技术成功实现选择性左束支起搏。
AI.motivation: 右位心合并完全性心脏传导阻滞时，心脏解剖位置反转使左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）的标测与导管操作更具挑战；既往相关病例和技术经验有限，亟需可行的简化影像标测与操作策略。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为77岁女性，右位心合并完全性心脏传导阻滞。干预为简化解剖标测影像结合改良导管技术，行左束支区域起搏；主要观察终点为是否成功实现选择性左束支起搏（LBBP）。摘要未报告随访时间、起搏参数及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要报告该患者成功实现选择性左束支起搏；未报告穿刺次数、手术时间、透视时间、起搏阈值、感知参数、并发症及随访结果等具体数据。
AI.conclusion: 结果提示，简化解剖标测影像与改良导管技术可能为右位心合并完全性心脏传导阻滞患者实施LBBAP提供可行路径，对解剖异常患者的起搏策略有参考价值；但证据仅来自单例病例，安全性与长期有效性尚需更多病例和随访验证。
